blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — The Municipal Trial Court (MTC) of Virac last week dismissed a five-year-old criminal complaint against former Catanduanes Gov. Joseph “Boboy” Cua, ruling that his constitutional right to the speedy disposition of cases had been violated by “inordinate and unjustified delays.” Criminal Case No. 7174 stemmed from a complaint filed in 2020 by Virac Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Officer Andy Po before the Office of the Ombudsman. Po had claimed that the construction of the Palnab Shipyard in Barangay Palnab del Sur proceeded without a building permit, an Environmental Compliance Certificate nor clearance from the Department […]...
